runtime_binding.why: metal crate 0.29.0 -- the same crate and the same Device::system_default() call the runtime uses -- returned 'Apple M3 Ultra' here. The language binding is not the suspect; it is the binding that failed in the blocked run.

shader_compilation.still_not_a_measurement: the compiler service was exercised, not the GPU: no command queue was created and nothing was dispatched
shader_compilation.why_it_matters: load_or_compile_shader_library falls back to device.new_library_with_source when no metallib cache is warm, and the xcrun precompile path is optional and gated behind HAWKING_METALLIB_BUILD. So the absent offline compiler does not block execution here -- it forces source compilation on a cold start, which is a cost, not a wall.

what_this_does_not_establish: that the blocked capture will now succeed; that binary was not run here

verdict.why: MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice() returned 'Apple M3 Ultra' from an ordinary command-line process on this host, and MTLCopyAllDevices() reports 1 device(s). A Rust Device::system_default() returning None is therefore a property of that process, not of the machine.

why_not_a_measurement: device enumeration only. No command queue is created, no work is submitted, no lease is taken, and no timing is recorded.
